question: Should this broad topic/session management request stay open as the umbrella for residual TUI, CLI lifecycle, metadata, and import/export scope, or should maintainers split the leftovers into narrower canonical issues now that Web UI thread management mostly exists on main?
rationale: Current main satisfies important Web UI and chat-naming parts, but the remaining work changes user-facing workflow and session-state semantics across CLI, TUI, Gateway metadata, and import/export, which needs maintainer product scope rather than an automatic fix PR.

options.title: Split Residual Scope
options.body: Close or narrow this umbrella only after creating/confirming canonical issues for CLI lifecycle, TUI management, metadata/tags/search, and import/export semantics.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad product tracker and use linked PRs/issues as implementation slices.

options.title: Declare Web UI Enough
options.body: Treat the current Web UI/chat implementation as sufficient and explicitly reject the residual TUI/CLI/import-export scope for now.

recommendation.title: Split Residual Scope
recommendation.body: Close or narrow this umbrella only after creating/confirming canonical issues for CLI lifecycle, TUI management, metadata/tags/search, and import/export semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the merged session thread management PR and the current session grouping/category work, making them the clearest owner for the product-scope split.
